milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak_wall_sign is at spawn-relative (2, 1, 0) on a fence post. max_distance reduced from 16 to 4 based on ValidatorAgent feedback — the sign is only ~2.24 blocks from spawn, so a large radius would trivially trigger. With max_distance=4 and facing_tolerance=60, the player must be close AND looking at the sign, preventing accidental completion from spawn without intentional observation.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The cauldron is at spawn-relative (10, 1, 3) inside the cobblestone workshop building. max_distance reduced from 16 to 6 based on ValidatorAgent feedback — this ensures the player must navigate to the building doorway (at x=7) or inside the building to trigger. From the doorway at (7,1,0), distance to cauldron is ~4.24 (within range). From spawn (0,0,0), distance is ~10.49 (outside range). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the cauldron.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a lever results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player crafts a lever from 1 stick + 1 cobblestone at the crafting table inside the workshop. No lever exists in the scene initially, so having min_count=1 confirms successful crafting.
